instruction: Set the system timezone to UTC
Set the keyboard layout to us
Configure network interface with static IP
output:
cat > /etc/network/interfaces << 'EOF'
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet static
	address 192.168.1.100
	netmask 255.255.255.0
	gateway 192.168.1.1
	dns-nameservers 8.8.8.8
EOF && systemctl restart networking
fallocate -l 2G /swapfile && chmod 600 /swapfile && mkswap /swapfile && swapon /swapfile && echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab

instruction: Set ulimit for a specific user
Configure PAM to enforce password complexity
output: apt install -y libpam-pwquality && echo 'password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3 minlen=12 difok=3' >> /etc/pam.d/common-password

instruction: Configure rsyslog to send logs to remote server

output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/myapp << 'EOF'
/var/log/myapp/*.log {
	daily
	rotate 7
	compress
	delaycompress
	missingok
	notifempty
	create 640 root root
}
EOF

instruction: Set default umask for all users
Configure SSH to use key auth only

output:
cat > /etc/fail2ban/jail.local << 'EOF'
[sshd]
enabled = true
maxretry = 3
bantime = 3600
findtime = 600
EOF && systemctl restart fail2ban

instruction: Configure auditd for system call monitoring
output: auditctl -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k passwd_changes && auditctl -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k shadow_changes
